hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market pools implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees. Each swap requires a signed off-chain sigma value to compute an exponential fee (e^[λ·(Δx/L)·σ]−1); collected USDC fees are routed to a YieldDistributor for share holders rather than LPs. Blocks swaps and liquidity operations when the market is resolved or disputed.
